description: Performs causal root-cause debugging before fixes. Use for bugs, crashes, failing tests or builds, intermittent behavior, regressions, incorrect state, networking failures, or performance anomalies. Requires reproduction/evidence, a falsifiable hypothesis, minimal diagnostic experiments, and architecture reassessment after repeated failed hypotheses.
